issues.description: Default config path points outside the package and config.yaml is not packaged, so installed console scripts can fail with FileNotFoundError.
Package discovery only includes emovec*, leaving top-level runtime data like config.yaml out of built wheels.
generate-stories requires an existing stories manifest, so it cannot bootstrap the empty data/stories directory documented in README.
from_pretrained uses dtype= despite declaring transformers>=4.42, whose compatible argument is torch_dtype=.
mean_activations divides by L - s without guarding one-token or empty-token inputs, so blank/degenerate stories can crash.
emotion_vectors averages empty label groups without validation, producing NaN vectors instead of a clear error.
pca_components divides by zero variance for constant inputs, producing NaN explained ratios/components.
Story loading blindly reads expected files without checking missing, empty, or too-short story content before extraction.
Story generation HTTP requests have no timeout, retry, or structured error handling, so runs can hang indefinitely.
The only test validating the story dataset is skipped when data/stories/manifest.json is absent, masking the repo's missing input data.
Generated experiment artifacts are present in the source tree even though outputs/ is ignored, making the repo state non-clean and non-reproducible.
Generated egg-info metadata is present in-tree despite being ignored, risking stale packaging metadata during cleanup.
